scope_detail: Complete local dispatcher API, mock/snapshot, global and decorator modules. Full local partial range only; no whole main-host promotion. Published dispatcher-instance methods require successful compiled configure/global publication and a supported observer/API call. Frozen-global fallback is not the cross-package bridge. Private bundled namespace exports are not supported product API publication. BASE Jouzu unbundled entry is separate; compiled/unbundled equivalence and ordinary terminal paint are not inferred. No audited module, network, process, native stream, mock, snapshot or UI operation runs.
